title: Lock-In Program Parameters — Pharmacy Benefit
content:
Parameters of the restricted recipient (lock-in) program of the Pharmacy Benefit, by PrairieRx plan.

| PrairieRx plan | Lock-in eligible | Lock-in lasts (calendar months from the start) | Distinct prescribers of controlled substances in 90 days that trigger review | Distinct pharmacies filling controlled substances in 90 days that trigger review | Written notice before the start (calendar days) | Member-requested lock-in pharmacy changes, rolling 365 days | Emergency fill at another pharmacy when the lock-in pharmacy is closed or out of stock |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| PrairieRx Dual Wrap | No | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | No |
| PrairieRx Expansion Adult | Yes | 24 | 4 | 4 | 30 | 1 | Yes |
| PrairieRx Adult | Yes | 24 | 4 | 4 | 30 | 1 | Yes |
| PrairieRx Children | No | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | No |
| PrairieRx Maternity | No | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | No |
| PrairieRx Complex Care | Yes | 24 | 4 | 4 | 30 | 1 | Yes |
| PrairieRx Long-Term Care | No | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | No |

A 0 entry marks a plan that is not lock-in eligible; it is not a threshold.

### Reading the sheet

Three plans are lock-in eligible — PrairieRx Expansion Adult, PrairieRx Adult and PrairieRx Complex Care — and they carry identical parameters: a 24-month lock-in, review triggered at 4 prescribers or 4 pharmacies of controlled substances in 90 days, 30 days of written notice, 1 member-requested pharmacy change in a rolling 365 days, and an emergency fill allowed elsewhere when the lock-in pharmacy is closed or out of stock.
